events.text: I'm out of credits, so I can't run the image edit. The cheapest model, flux-2-klein at 5 credits, was already the one I'd have used. I'll lay out the options: do the edit locally in any image editor, or top up credits. I can also give brief step-by-step instructions for doing it by hand.

I couldn't make the story version. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so the edit was refused and nothing was created.

I'd already chosen the cheapest setting your free plan allows: the flux-2-klein model at 640px, one image, about 5 credits. So there's no cheaper way to do it on Magic Hour.

**To get it made:**
- **Add credits:** if you top up your account, I'll run the same edit. I'll keep the whole photo with all your hair and shoulders, put a blurred, enlarged copy behind it at the top and bottom, and add no text.
- **Do it yourself for free:** you don't need AI for this. In Canva, CapCut or the Instagram story editor:
  1. Make a 1080×1920 canvas.
  2. Add your photo, stretch it to fill the whole canvas and blur it heavily. This is the background.
  3. Add the photo again on top, 1080 px wide and centred, without cropping it.

The second way gives you exactly what you described and doesn't change your face at all. An AI edit might change it slightly.
